role: The one HTTP send seam for the web-API clients in Services/ (Overpass, MET Norway, Tavily, OpenTopoData): a Sendable value wrapping a send closure, `live` in the app, a stub in tests.
types: HTTPTransport: struct — Sendable wrapper around `send: @Sendable (URLRequest) async throws -> (Data, URLResponse)`
toplevel: Declares HTTPTransport with its memberwise init(send:). No stored state.

units.does: Returns an HTTPTransport whose send calls URLSession.shared.data(for:) and returns its data and response, throwing what URLSession throws.
units.entry: Default argument of OverpassClient.init, WeatherService.init, WebSearchService.init and TopoElevationService.elevations, so every app-built client sends through it.
reads: net:any URL a client sends to
